Chinese: WSL Bridge 是一款面向 Windows 10/11 的桌面网络工具，帮助您将 WSL、Hyper-V 和静态主机服务稳定暴露到本机或局域网。内置 Proxy 反向代理工作台、结构化 Hosts 分组管理、Legacy Rules 兼容管理、统一流量监控，以及面向 AI Agent 的 MCP/Skill 集成。支持 HTTP/HTTPS 监听、TLS 终止、按 Server Name 分流、WebSocket、gRPC/gRPCS、路径前缀改写、多网卡绑定和拓扑自动发现。
English: WSL Bridge is a Windows 10/11 desktop networking toolkit for exposing and operating services from WSL, Hyper-V, and static host targets on localhost or LAN. It includes a dedicated Proxy workspace, structured Hosts group management, legacy Rules compatibility, unified traffic monitoring, and built-in MCP/Skill integration for AI agents. Features include HTTP/HTTPS listeners, TLS termination, server-name-based routing, WebSocket, gRPC/gRPCS, path-prefix rewrite, multi-NIC binding, and automatic topology discovery.
